From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: ExecOps (execops@acme.com), Susan Park <susan@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder closure docket — QBR readiness & exec asks

Team — kicking off a short thread to consolidate outstanding exec asks and closure items for next week's QBR with Acme. Goal: get to a 1-slide list of open risks + owners by EOD Thursday so ExecOps has time to review.

Quick context: Acme flagged two runway topics during the last sync — (1) the dedicated-capacity rollback scenario and (2) an SLA exception request for token retention on the PII pipeline. They expect our answers in the QBR review on 5/18.

Asks (please update status inline):
- Lauren: finalize the rollback mitigation plan (owner: lauren_bishop) — need a short blurb + expected timeline.
- Marissa: confirm procurement path & proposed credits for the SLA exception (owner: marissa_cole) — Acme asked for a one-time credit ask.
- Vivek: executive summary on tech risk / fallback (owner: vivek_kulkarni).

I've attached a working register (QBR_Ask_Register_v2.xlsx) with current items. Please: 1) add your short bullets under "Closure Notes" column, 2) set a target closure date, and 3) flag any open dependencies.

Attachments: [Attachment: QBR_Ask_Register_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Director, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: ExecOps (execops@acme.com)
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder closure docket — QBR readiness & exec asks

Thanks Priyom — I updated the register with a mitigation blurb and timeline. Summary below and added to the sheet.

Rollback mitigation (summary):
- Cause: capacity autoscale oversubscribe during model spike.
- Immediate mitigation: limit burst to current reserved pool + warm standby image for the last-stable model (1 hour rollout).
- Timeline: engineering can validate the warm-standby in staging by 5/13, and we can schedule the one-hour fallback release 5/15-5/16.
- Residual risk: 5–10% throughput hit for highest-concurrency jobs for up to 24 hours post-fallback.

I've set the target closure date to 2027-05-15 on the sheet. If Marissa can confirm whether Acme accepts a 24-hour throughput warning window, we can close.

On Proc credits: I suggest a staged credit (10% month-of rollback) tied to measured error-rate deltas — cc Marissa to align.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@acme.com>, ExecOps (execops@acme.com)
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder closure docket — QBR readiness & exec asks

Thanks — I filled in the procurement path and sketched the credit approach in the sheet. Notes:
- One-time credit ask is feasible; finance needs the final scope (duration + usage delta). Recommend we propose a 10% credit for the rollback month with a cap of $15k (preliminary).
- Doc for approvals: I'll start an internal approval ticket and aim to have sign-off by EOD 5/14.

Action items added to register:
- Marissa: open approval ticket w/ finance (target 2027-05-14).
- Marissa: draft credit memo and send to Priyom for exec sign-off (target 2027-05-15).

Attachment: [Attachment: SLA-exception-summary.pdf (pdf)]

@Lauren — agree with staged credit approach. If Acme insists on a longer credit period, get me the usage delta number and I'll recalc cap.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder closure docket — QBR readiness & exec asks

Quick tech note — pulled from infra:
- Warm-standby validation looks good in perf tests; latency delta under fallback is ~120–180ms p95 on medium payloads.
- For the PII retention ask, legal flagged logging retention policy changes that require Security & Legal approval (this is bigger than a pure infra change). We should limit promises to the customer until Legal signs off.

Open dependencies I added to the register:
- Legal review (owner: legal@redwood.ai) — estimate 3 business days if triaged now.
- Prod runbook update (owner: infra-runbooks) — low effort, target 5/14.

If Legal clearance stretches past 5/14, propose we present the mitigation + commitment to get Legal review done by 5/21 and offer an interim operational guardrail for Acme (detailed in the attached sheet).

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, ExecOps (execops@acme.com), Susan Park <susan@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder closure docket — QBR readiness & exec asks

Appreciate the fast turn. Quick status and next steps for the QBR slide:
- Lauren: finalize 2–3 bullet summary of rollback mitigation (deadline 5/13 EOD) — DONE in sheet.
- Marissa: confirmation of credit approach + approval ticket (target 5/14) — in progress. Please tag me on the approval ticket.
- Vivek: request Legal to prioritize the PII retention memo; if Legal cannot commit by 5/14, we present interim guardrail with target Legal completion 5/21.

For Acme (cc'd): we will come to the QBR with the mitigation plan + a clear timeline for Legal review. If anything changes materially, Priyom will loop back before the meeting.

Final: I'm preparing the one-slide exec summary and will share a draft by 5/14 morning. Link to folder with slides and register below.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12qR-ExampleQBRFolder

Thanks — Priyom
